meta.title: Acuɣeṛ ssɛaya n Qarṭaǧ tesserfeg Ṛuma
meta.desc: Ternad snat tikwal, Qarṭaǧ tettuɣal tenker: lexlaṣ n 241 d 201, lexlaṣ uzrib, tiẓurin n Katun, uminti n 149. Amek ssɛaya n Qarṭaǧ tuɣal d ahaǧas i Ṛuma.
hero.alt: Šikel n lfeṭṭa aqarṭaǧi: aqerru n Melqart d lfil
hero.caption: Šikel n lfeṭṭa, 213–210 uqbel Ɛisa — Melqart d lfil · Asinag Abritani
hero.title: Teɣleb ssɛaya-ines Ṛuma
hero.lede: Ternad snat tikwal, Qarṭaǧ tettuɣal tenker. D ssɛaya-ines, ugar n lseɣ-ines, i d-yuɣalen d ahaǧas i Ṛuma.
stats.0.t: n yimezdaɣ ass uqbel 149 ɣef leḥsab n Strabun — uṭṭun ahat yemɣaṛ
stats.1.t: n lfeṭṭa yal ass (≈ 100 kg): ayen i d-yeffeɣ seg lbir n Baebelo i Hanibal, ɣef leḥsab n Plin Amɣar
stats.2.t: talanṭ n lexlaṣ i gettwasbedden deg 201 uqbel Ɛisa, ɣef 50 iseggasen (≈ 260 d ṭunan n lfeṭṭa)
stats.3.t: seld-asen, Qarṭaǧ tessumer ad texles kullec s yiwet n tikkelt
gear.title: Abrid ɣer uɣelluy, seg tegzirin n Egadi ar 146
gear.items.0.d: Terna di tegzirin n Egadi, Qarṭaǧ teǧǧa Sqilliya. Amɣiwan isbedd 2 200 n talanṭ ɣef ɛecrin iseggasen; aɣref aṛumi issaɣ-it ɣer 3 200 n talanṭ ɣef mraw iseggasen (Bulib).
gear.items.1.d: S tɛawant n umennuɣ n Iɛeskriyen Uqeṛḍasen, Ṛuma teṭṭef Sardinya tessutur 1 200 n talanṭ nniḍen s ttaẓ n umennuɣ. Ula Bulib yesteqsa ɣef lḥaq deg waya.
gear.items.2.d: Seld Zama: asutel n yibabuṛen yeqqim ala s mraw, ilfan ttunefken, 100 n iḥebsiyen, ur yezmir ara ad yexdem amennuɣ war tsentem n Ṛuma, d 10 000 n talanṭ n lfeṭṭa ara ixelsen deg 50 iseggasen.
gear.items.3.d: Yettwafren d amenẓaw amenzu, yenɣa fell-as rrecwa n yimeqqranen, yessken-d dakken lexlaṣ n tmurt yezmer ad ixelleṣ Ṛuma war tabzert tamaynut (Titus Livyus). Icenfiren-is ttuɣalen-t-id ɣer Ṛuma; iṛuḥ ɣer unebdu deg 195.
gear.items.4.d: Ɣef leḥsab n Titus Livyus, Qarṭaǧ tessumer ad texles ayen i d-yeqqimen s yiwet n tikkelt. Ṛuma tugi: ṭṭayn-agi yella daɣen d azrar.
gear.items.5.d: Yuɣal-d seg usiwel ɣer Tafrikt, Katun yessers deg Usqamu tiẓurin mazal-itent froẖ: tamurt-agi i tent-id-yessefraḥen, inna-d, ur tezri ara ɣer tlata n wussan s lebḥer (Plutark, Plin). Timnazaɛt d taɛamart, daɣen tqeṛṛeb aṭas. Seg assen, iseggem yal adiwenni-s s usutur n uhuddu n Qarṭaǧ.
gear.items.6.d: Lexlaṣ aneggaru n lexlaṣ yettwaxelles. Yettwaḥkem fell-as sɣur Masinisa, Qarṭaǧ tessers aɛesskar akken ad tḥader iman-is war tsentem n Ṛuma — ayen ixulfen amɣiwan n 201 yefkan i Ṛuma ssebba n umennuɣ.
gear.items.7.d: Ɣef leḥsab n Appyan, Qarṭaǧ tefka 300 n warrac d iḥebsiyen, sakin 200 000 n ssla d 2 000 n tmesnin… send ma Ṛuma tesra fell-as ad teǧǧ tamdint teɣres ɣer 80 n listadyat (≈ 15 km) seg lebḥer. Agdel: tamdint tḥuder iman-is tlata iseggasen, armi 146.
why.title: Acuɣeṛ annect-agi n ttbaɛ?
why.aside: Iɣbula iqdimen s yiman-nsen skanayen aṭas n ssebbat — kkulhent n Ṛuma.
why.items.0.title: « Ilaq ad tettwahudd Qarṭaǧ »
why.items.0.cite: « Daɣen, ɣileɣ ilaq ad tettwahudd Qarṭaǧ. »
why.items.0.text: Plutark yeqqar-d dakken Katun ad ifak yal avis-ines s lexṭaṛ-agi; tanfalit talatinit ismawen-ines d tiddit i d-ixedmen ɣer deffir. « Carthago delenda est » d lqaɛt-ines tawezzlant.
why.items.1.title: Tikta yelhan n lxuf
why.items.1.text: Deg Usqamu, Nasika yettara-d belli ilaq ad tqqim Qarṭaǧ: lxuf seg tmenɣaṣt (metus Punicus) yettḥareb ṭṭbiɛa n Ṛumaniyen. Salust ad d-yini ɣer deffir belli asmi i tenger Qarṭaǧ, d asmi i tebda trusi n Ṛuma.
why.items.2.title: Tamdint yesɛan ugar n ssɛaya deg umaḏal
why.items.2.text: D anaẓur n uhuzi, Bulib yeqqar-d dakken tettwassen d tamdint yesɛan ugar n ssɛaya deg umaḏal. Seld 146, Usqamu yessuqel ula d adlis n Magun ɣef tfellaḥt ɣer talatinit: Ṛuma tḥuda timnazaɛt-is maca teṭṭef tamusni-ines.
cmp.title: Sin n yiḥricen i wudem n wudem
cmp.rows.0.1: Tekka-d seg ttjara n lebḥer d tfellaḥt
cmp.rows.2.1: Azal ameqqran deg lebḥer seg zik
cmp.rows.2.2: Asutel yettwabnan deg tmenɣut tamezwarut tapunikt
ports.text: Ldgar dayrawi yeṭṭef asutel n umennuɣ; ldgar amrabaɛ, ttjara.
related.0.title: Tamurt n ttjara
related.0.text: Ttjara, tafellaḥt, idrimen: iɣbula n ssɛaya n Qarṭaǧ.
related.1.title: Aṭṭef n Qarṭaǧ
related.1.text: Ayen i texdem Ṛuma, akked wayen i d-tenna dakken txedem.
related.2.title: Amezruy n yimerbaḥ
related.2.text: Qarṭaǧ i d-ḥekkun yicenfiren-is: ɣeṛ iɣbula s laql.
